arrayOrder: row-major north-to-south, west-to-east; node E=x0+c*2, N=y0-r*2
basis: Shared separable bilinear hat basis at 16/8/4/2m; finest explicit residual, evaluated to Float32 display nodes. Not a universal/frozen KAOPU schema.
geometrySampling: R03 triangle topology NW-SW-NE / NE-SW-SE; sample triangle from reconstructed nodes, not direct spectral bilinear query for contact.

datum.method: Bilinear interpolation of model difference using per-patch controls; source HKPD retained unchanged separately
datum.absoluteAccuracy: unknown; computational residual is not survey accuracy

source.provider: Civil Engineering and Development Department, HKSAR Government
